rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for covering a road or other route with a hard surface.

example.english: The government will pave a road through the village to make it easier for residents to get around.
example.traditional: 政府會喺村入面鋪路，方便村民出入。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 wui5 hai2 cyun1 jap6 min6 pou1 lou6 fong1 bin6 cyun1 man4 ceot1 jap6

rows.note: Use this figurative construction when something prepares the conditions for a later result.

example.english: This internship will pave the way for me to find a job in the future.
example.traditional: 今次實習會為我將來搵工鋪路。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 sat6 zaap6 wui5 wai6 ngo5 zoeng1 loi4 wan2 gung1 pou1 lou6

rows.note: Use this when the surface is specifically covered with paving bricks or tiles.

example.english: The workers will pave our balcony with tiles today.
example.traditional: 師傅今日會幫我哋個露台鋪磚。
example.jyutping: si1 fu2 gam1 jat6 wui5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 go3 lou6 toi1 pou1 zyun1
